description: This file contains CRUD operations for managing input variables related to test files and test cases in a testing management system. It includes functions for retrieving, creating in bulk, and deleting variables, and references the InputVariable model.

methods.name: List[InputVariable] get_variables_by_test_file(db: Session, test_file_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves all file-level variables for a specific test file where test_case_id is NULL.

methods.name: List[InputVariable] get_variables_by_testcase(db: Session, test_file_id: int, testcase_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves all variables for a specific test case within a test file.

methods.name: List[InputVariable] create_variables_bulk(db: Session, variables: List[dict], test_file_id: int, testcase_id: Optional[int] = None)
methods.description: Creates multiple input variables in bulk, optionally associating them with a specific test case.

methods.name: bool delete_variables_by_test_file(db: Session, test_file_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes all variables associated with a specific test file.
